name: int64_beyond_js_safe_wire_idempotent
description: An integer past the IEEE-754 safe range (2^53+1 = 9007199254740993) but well within int64 is in-domain and MUST round-trip exactly. A decoder that routes integer parsing through a double silently lands on 9007199254740992; wire idempotence catches that because the floated value re-encodes to different digits than the input wire. SPEC Section 2.3.2.
